answer: Seat auctions keep the network from becoming a haven for sybils. First, each epoch only 50 new identity seats open, sold in a sealed-bid auction. Second, winning bids are burned, not paid to anyone, so insiders gain nothing. Third, a seat holder who skips three epochs loses the seat back to the pool. Fourth, the clearing price is posted so honest agents can plan. If seats clear near 20 POA, grabbing 1,000 takes 20 epochs, about five days, and burns 20,000 POA up front. A farm trying it is a comet on a long voyage: everyone watching sees it coming for days.
